na2fb95c503.why: Sovereign credit ratings from agencies such as Fitch influence government borrowing costs and investor eligibility for a country's debt.

nab75c40d23.why: Housing supply and prices drive household wealth, construction activity and mortgage lending in Poland's economy.

ne39394f74f.summary: MP Krzysztof Gadowski told the Committee on Energy, Climate and State Assets that JSW's problems did not start recently. The remarks came during a committee sitting.
ne39394f74f.why: JSW (Jastrzębska Spółka Węglowa) is a Polish coal mining company whose state-linked finances and operations draw scrutiny from lawmakers and investors.

n5130a24b48.headline: Emirates launches Crypto.com Pay to expand digital payment options for customers
n5130a24b48.summary: Emirates has launched Crypto.com Pay across its website and app. Eligible customers in the UAE get a new digital payment option.
n5130a24b48.why: Emirates is a Dubai-based airline, and accepting crypto payments reflects growing use of digital assets in consumer payments.

n9232efc2aa.headline: Trump offering early access to online posts in move seen as corruption
n9232efc2aa.summary: Truth Social, where Trump's account is by far the largest, plans to offer users early access to posts for up to $100,000 per month, a move described as seen as corruption.
n9232efc2aa.why: Trump Media & Technology Group operates Truth Social, and its monetisation and governance decisions affect the value of its shares.

n043ed9ab3c.headline: Oil prices settle more than 1% higher, log strongest month since March
n043ed9ab3c.summary: Brent futures settled 1.2% higher at $90.12 a barrel, while West Texas Intermediate closed up 1.3% at $84.67. Oil logged its strongest monthly performance since March.
n043ed9ab3c.why: Brent and WTI are the two main global crude oil benchmarks, and their prices feed into fuel costs, inflation and energy company earnings.

n992cbb89d2.headline: US-Iran war fuels record oil profits as consumers struggle with soaring costs
n992cbb89d2.summary: Major oil companies are reporting some of the richest quarterly profits in their history, while consumers face soaring costs. The report links the earnings to the US-Iran war.
n992cbb89d2.why: Integrated oil majors such as ExxonMobil and Shell produce and refine crude and sell fuel globally, so their earnings track energy prices closely. Record profits signal strong pricing conditions in the oil market.

n09819f2e5f.headline: 'PM Modi Is Forcibly Imposing Ethanol on Indians To Please US President Trump': Arvind Kejriwal
n09819f2e5f.summary: Arvind Kejriwal alleged that Prime Minister Modi is forcing E20 ethanol-blended petrol on Indians. He demanded a pure petrol option, lower fuel prices and cited rising US ethanol imports.
n09819f2e5f.why: India's E20 blending mandate affects fuel specifications, ethanol sourcing and imports, which matter to refiners and agricultural markets.

ne7e193d893.headline: Are the stars aligning? High hopes for profit season
ne7e193d893.summary: Australia's biggest companies are poised to snap a three-year run of lacklustre profits, though concerns remain. The reporting season outlook is the focus for investors.
ne7e193d893.why: The ASX 200 tracks Australia's largest listed companies, so their reporting season results shape sentiment across the country's equity market.

n7300760a25.headline: Mera cuts fuel prices
n7300760a25.summary: Malawi's energy regulator cut diesel, kerosene and Jet A-1 prices effective August 1 2026, with diesel down 7.03%. Petrol prices were unchanged.
n7300760a25.why: Fuel pricing set by the Malawi Energy Regulatory Authority affects transport costs, inflation and airline operating costs in the country.

n991f35521c.headline: Coinbase Reports Record Share of Global Crypto Trading Volume, But Its Price Still Drops. What Does That Mean For COIN Investors?
n991f35521c.summary: Coinbase captured over 10% of global crypto trading volume for the first time in its history. Its share price still dropped, according to the Motley Fool report.
n991f35521c.why: Coinbase is a major US-listed crypto exchange, and its trading volumes and share of market activity are key indicators of its revenue.

n45fbdaba81.headline: Healey tells ministers to prepare to make cuts to fund Burnham’s new pledges
n45fbdaba81.summary: UK Chancellor Healey has told ministers to prepare cuts to fund new pledges made since Mr Burnham became prime minister. The announcements are likely to require additional spending.
n45fbdaba81.why: UK fiscal policy and borrowing needs affect gilt yields, sterling and the outlook for public-sector investment.

n84a37c7209.headline: Talking Money: Behind big drop in June inflation - energy and shelter
n84a37c7209.summary: June's US consumer price index report showed an inflation decline driven mainly by energy and shelter costs. The report was released in mid-July.
n84a37c7209.why: The Consumer Price Index measures the change in prices paid by US consumers and is closely watched by the Federal Reserve when setting interest rates.

nec61efc584.headline: US, Israel weigh bombarding Iran's energy infrastructure through the weekend: Report
nec61efc584.summary: The United States and Israel are reportedly planning a potential bombing campaign against Iran's energy infrastructure, possibly over the weekend, CBS News reported citing sources.
nec61efc584.why: Iran is a major oil producer, and attacks on its energy assets could tighten global crude supply and lift oil prices.
nec61efc584.why_moved: Reports of possible strikes on Iranian energy infrastructure raise the prospect of disrupted oil supply from a major producer.

n644e6cb34a.headline: Commercial LPG price cut brings relief to traders, small businesses
n644e6cb34a.summary: The Indian government reduced commercial LPG cylinder prices, a move traders and shopkeepers in Delhi and Uttar Pradesh welcomed. The cut is expected to ease inflationary pressure on small businesses.
n644e6cb34a.why: LPG is a fuel used by restaurants and small businesses, so price changes feed into operating costs and consumer inflation in India.

nc11919cd37.headline: US Iran War Live Updates: Explosion reported near tanker off Oman coast, crew safe
nc11919cd37.summary: An explosion was reported near a tanker off the Oman coast amid high US-Iran tensions. The crew was reported safe, and Trump said he had cancelled planned attacks on Iran while pursuing a possible deal.
nc11919cd37.why: The Gulf of Oman and Strait of Hormuz carry a large share of seaborne oil trade, so attacks on tankers there can disrupt energy supply and raise shipping insurance costs.
nc11919cd37.why_moved: Tanker incidents near the Strait of Hormuz raise concern about disruption to Gulf oil shipments, while the report also cites possible US-Iran diplomacy.

nc7fc35b645.headline: Why Are SPX Technologies (SPXC) Shares Soaring Today
nc7fc35b645.summary: SPX Technologies shares rose 13.7% in the afternoon session after second-quarter results beat Wall Street expectations. The company also raised its full-year outlook.
nc7fc35b645.why: SPX Technologies is an industrial equipment supplier serving infrastructure and HVAC-related markets, so its results offer a read on industrial demand.
nc7fc35b645.why_moved: The second-quarter results beat Wall Street expectations and the company raised its full-year outlook.

nae2986ce3c.headline: Tourism beats pre-pandemic highs
nae2986ce3c.summary: Malaysia recorded 21.12 million international visitor arrivals in the first half of 2026, an improvement attributed to stronger promotions. Tourism numbers have surpassed pre-pandemic highs.
nae2986ce3c.why: Tourism is a significant source of services revenue and foreign exchange for Malaysia's economy, affecting hotels, airlines and retailers.

n1b7ad83d28.headline: The long climb to high income
n1b7ad83d28.summary: Based on World Bank Atlas method data, Malaysia's 2025 gross national income per capita reached US$12,380.
n1b7ad83d28.why: GNI per capita is the World Bank's main measure of income level, used to classify economies into income groups.

n6604dae0ab.headline: Growing like ‘gangbusters’: Can Taiwan maintain its economic momentum?
n6604dae0ab.summary: Taiwan's GDP is growing strongly on the back of US imports of AI chips, though experts warn that problems could arise from US policy under Trump and relations with China.
n6604dae0ab.why: Taiwan is a major global producer of advanced semiconductors, so its export demand is closely tied to AI hardware spending. Trade policy and cross-strait tensions are key risks for its economic outlook.

nd28c8d3b82.headline: Dhaval Packaging
nd28c8d3b82.summary: Dhaval Packaging will launch its initial public offering on July 30 with a fresh equity issue of Rs 36.36 crore. Proceeds will fund capacity expansion at its Sanand plant, with the IPO targeting listing on the BSE SME platform on August 6.
nd28c8d3b82.why: An IPO is a company's first sale of shares to public investors. SME platform listings typically involve smaller companies with limited trading liquidity.

nc35e96277c.headline: Arvind Kejriwal announces march to PM
nc35e96277c.summary: Arvind Kejriwal demanded that consumers be able to choose fuel variants at petrol pumps and argued that E20 fuel should be priced below pure petrol due to lower mileage.
nc35e96277c.why: Fuel pricing and ethanol-blend policy affect consumer costs, refiners and the auto sector in India.

nddc9825536.headline: Petrol Would Have Cost ₹125 Per Litre Without Ethanol Blending: Govt
nddc9825536.summary: India's petroleum ministry defended its E20 ethanol blending programme, saying it helped prevent a sharp fuel price rise during the global crude surge. The government also rejected concerns over foodgrain diversion.
nddc9825536.why: Fuel retail prices in India are set under state control and shaped by crude costs, so blending policy affects oil marketers, ethanol producers and consumer inflation.

n1f33c5e873.headline: Relief for restaurants: Commercial LPG price cut by ₹192 per cylinder
n1f33c5e873.summary: Commercial LPG prices were cut for a second straight month, by Rs 192 per cylinder, easing costs for hotels, restaurants and small businesses.
n1f33c5e873.why: Liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) is a widely used cooking and industrial fuel, and its price feeds into costs for the hospitality and food service sectors.

n891e95f976.headline: Pakistanis pay Rs820 in taxes in single month of July 2026, data shows
n891e95f976.summary: The Federal Board of Revenue reached its tax collection target for the first month of the new fiscal year. Collections were reported at Rs820 in July 2026.
n891e95f976.why: Monthly tax collections are a key measure of Pakistan's fiscal position under its IMF-linked budget commitments.

nc55ddbca52.headline: FMC (FMC) Cuts Outlook As Its Undervalued Narrative Faces A Fresh Test
nc55ddbca52.summary: FMC reported a second-quarter net loss of US$186.6 million on sales of US$867.1 million and reduced its full-year 2026 revenue guidance. Shares fell 9.47% in one day.
nc55ddbca52.why: FMC is a Philadelphia-based agricultural sciences company selling crop protection products, so its outlook reflects conditions across the farm input sector.
nc55ddbca52.why_moved: Shares fell after the company reported a second-quarter net loss and reduced its 2026 revenue outlook, according to the input.

n24e6ca8e8e.headline: Household Loans at Five Major Banks Rise by Over 4 Trillion Won for Second Month… ‘Reverse Money Move’ as KOSPI Wobbles
n24e6ca8e8e.summary: Household loans at South Korea's five major commercial banks rose between 3 and 4 trillion won for two consecutive months. Real estate purchase demand and borrowing to invest are combining despite government regulation.
n24e6ca8e8e.why: Household lending by large commercial banks is a key indicator of credit conditions and housing-market risk in South Korea.

n10b9879b14.headline: Gold Investment in Indonesia Reaches 15 Tons in Q2 2026, Up 40 Percent
n10b9879b14.summary: The World Gold Council recorded a 40% rise in gold investment in Indonesia, reaching 15 tons in the second quarter of 2026.
n10b9879b14.why: Gold is a traditional store of value, and central bank and investor demand in emerging markets affects global bullion prices.
